zones.label: Deep Core
zones.description: The most ancient and densely packed region of the galaxy. Hyperspace travel here is extraordinarily dangerous.

zones.label: Core Worlds
zones.description: The political and cultural heart of the galaxy. Seat of the Republic, then the Empire. Coruscant. Corellia. Alderaan.

zones.label: Colonies
zones.description: The first worlds settled beyond the Core. Prosperous, stable, firmly under galactic authority.

zones.label: Inner Rim
zones.description: Older than the Colonies, more independent in character. Wealth and politics in roughly equal measure.

zones.label: Expansion Region
zones.description: Heavily industrialized during the Republic's expansion era. Corporate interests dominate.

zones.label: Mid Rim
zones.description: The galaxy's working middle. Agricultural worlds, transit hubs, and frontier ambition.

zones.label: Outer Rim
zones.description: The frontier. Sparse Imperial presence. Independent operators, crime syndicates, and people who need to disappear.

zones.label: Hutt Space
zones.description: Hutt territory. Nominally independent, practically lawless. The Hutts don't rule through law — they rule through debt.

zones.label: Unknown Regions
zones.description: Uncharted. Hyperspace lanes don't reach here reliably. Things live in the Unknown Regions that the galaxy has forgotten.

zones.label: Wild Space
zones.description: Beyond the mapped galaxy. Occasional outposts, more occasional survivors. Enter with a good navicomputer and a better reason.
